aiOverview.content: The Toyota bZ7 electric sedan achieved over 3,100 orders within the first hour of its launch in China, highlighting strong initial demand for the new, tech-focused, and affordably priced luxury EV. Launched in late March 2026, the vehicle starts at approximately 147,800 yuan (~$21,500) and features advanced technology, including partnerships with Huawei, Xiaomi, and Momenta.Key details regarding the Toyota bZ7's, available on Electrek and CarNewsChina, launch include:Order Volume: Over 3,100 units within 60 minutes of the launch event.Pricing: The bZ7 is positioned as an affordable luxury sedan, starting around 147,800 Chinese yuan ($21,500) and going up to 199,800 yuan ($29,000).Key Features: The model is developed in collaboration with Chinese technology firms to offer advanced smart-cockpit features, LiDAR-based driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and a choice of 71-kWh or 88-kWh batteries providing up to 710 km (441 miles) of range.Market Position: This high-volume, quick-response launch is seen as a major, competitive move for Toyota in the Chinese electric vehicle market, notes CarNewsChina.The bZ7 is now available in Chinese dealerships with deliveries already beginning, according to Electrive.
